title: Account Signal VSL — CSAT fine, still know who's leaving
description: One wedge (Account Signal) for CS/churn. When CSAT says fine, know who's leaving — prove with words + next best action. No testimonials.

beats.voiceover: This is the last thing they told us before they left.
beats.caption: Fine. 7/10. — last thing before they left.

beats.voiceover: Three weeks later, gone. So why couldn't we see it?
beats.caption: Three weeks later — gone. Why couldn't we see it?

beats.voiceover: A score tells you someone's unhappy. Never why. And usually too late.
beats.onScreen: A score never tells you why.
beats.caption: A score tells you someone's unhappy. Never why. Usually too late.

beats.voiceover: Fine. Seven out of ten. Looks acceptable.
beats.caption: Fine. 7/10. Looks acceptable.

beats.voiceover: UpSight asks what fine actually means.
beats.caption: What does “fine” actually mean?

beats.voiceover: The receipt lands — exact quote, who said it, when, tagged renewal risk.
beats.caption: Quote · who · when · CFO froze spend.

beats.voiceover: It doesn't just flag the risk. It tells you the move.
beats.caption: Loop in the exec sponsor before renewal.

beats.voiceover: That pattern hits thirteen other accounts. A driver, not an anecdote.
beats.caption: One line → matched across 13 accounts.

beats.voiceover: What you have: a score dashboard, a spreadsheet of answers, guessing after the fact.
beats.caption: Score dashboard. Spreadsheet. Guessing after the fact.

beats.voiceover: What you needed: the meaning, what matters tagged and attributable, a warning and the move while you can still act.
beats.caption: Meaning. Tagged evidence. Warning + the move.

beats.voiceover: A form stops at seven. UpSight asks the next question, keeps the receipt, and tells you the move.
beats.caption: Asks the next question, keeps the receipt, tells you the move.

beats.voiceover: Pick two accounts you have some suspicions about. Thirty minutes.
beats.caption: Pick 2 accounts you have suspicions about. 30 min.

beats.voiceover: I'll show you what the form missed — and the next move. Before they hand you a seven on the way out.
beats.caption: What the form missed + the next move. Before the next 7.
